title: Bubble chart
description: Scatter charts with a third value drawn as the size of the dots: the area of a bubble is proportional to its value.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: GDP per capita against life expectancy, the bubbles sized by population and colored by continent; valueName and format name and format the value in the tooltip.

portfolio.title: Product portfolio
portfolio.description: Market share, market growth and revenue of the products, split in four quadrants by two reference lines; showLabels writes the names around the bubbles.

pipeline.title: Sales pipeline
pipeline.description: Open deals by days in the pipeline and win probability, sized by amount; onPointClick receives the value of the clicked bubble.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: GDP per capita, life expectancy and population: the bubble areas are proportional to the populations, written with the compact units of the locale in the tooltip.

data.countriesAria: GDP per capita, life expectancy and population of countries
data.portfolioAria: Market share, growth and revenue of the products
data.pipelineAria: Open deals by age, win probability and amount

BubbleChartProps.series: Series of points with a value sizing their bubble (area proportional to the value)

BubbleOptions.minSize: Diameter in pixels of the smallest bubbles
BubbleOptions.maxSize: Diameter in pixels of the largest value
BubbleOptions.maxValue: Value drawn with maxSize, to share a scale between charts; the largest value by default

countries.title: Wealth, health and population
countries.description: GDP per capita against life expectancy, bubbles sized by population (area proportional to the value).

portfolio.title: Portfolio risk and return
portfolio.description: One series per asset, sized by its share of the portfolio; clicking a bubble reports the asset.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
